response.sql: WITH pa AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS o FROM Laboratory), above AS (SELECT pa.ID, pa.avg_hgb FROM pa, overall WHERE pa.avg_hgb > overall.o) SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb AS avg_hgb, a.avg_hgb - (SELECT o FROM overall) AS diff_from_overall, a.avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM above) AS diff_from_above_avg FROM above a ORDER BY diff_from_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
